title: The Revised Transfer Form
brief: Meridian Care plans to replace the paper inter-ward transfer form with a revised version TF-3 next Monday. This visit covers management system topics only. Clinical decisions, clinical standards, and law are outside its scope; the investigator does not judge clinical care. You have 12 visit points to assess whether the change has been reviewed for risks, controls, communication, and records.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Ward managers: have you seen TF-3
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Change record DC-55 states the reason, the forms affected, and the approvers.
Draft TF-3 has a version number, owner, and approval block.
3 of 5 ward managers have not seen TF-3; go-live is in 4 days (survey note W-3).
evidence.whyItMatters: Changes must be communicated to those who use them.

evidence.text: Wards hold about 400 old TF-2 forms; DC-55 has no withdrawal step.
evidence.whyItMatters: Obsolete documents must be withdrawn or marked.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what happens to old stock.

evidence.text: No risk assessment of the change exists; TF-3 removes the "pending tasks" section found on TF-2 (section D).
evidence.whyItMatters: Risks from changes must be considered.
evidence.missedExplanation: Compare old and new versions for removed content.

evidence.text: Retention rules list TF-2 only; TF-3 is not added (schedule RS-2).
evidence.whyItMatters: Records rules should cover the new form.

evidence.text: Briefing plan BP-3 is a single email.
evidence.whyItMatters: A fuller briefing would support adoption.

evidence.text: Pilot on 1 ward for 2 days: 6 of 20 transfers had blank fields; no review of results is recorded (pilot log PL-1).
evidence.whyItMatters: Change results must be reviewed before rollout.
evidence.missedExplanation: Read pilot results and the response to them.

evidence.text: TF-3 is printed on a different colour paper.
Font size is slightly smaller than TF-2 but meets the house style.
The document owner is named and available.

decisions.prompt: Should TF-3 go live on Monday?
options: Not yet. Complete the risk review of the removed section, review pilot results, brief every ward, plan withdrawal of TF-2, and update retention rules; then set a date
Go live on 1 ward only without review
decisions.rationale: The change may be sound but its review is incomplete.

containment: Keep TF-2 in use until TF-3 is ready
correction: Complete risk review, pilot review, briefing, withdrawal plan, and retention update
cause: The document change process does not require risk review, pilot review, or withdrawal planning
corrective: Add these steps to the document change procedure
effectiveness: Audit the next five document changes

debriefText.found: You checked communication, withdrawal, risk, and pilot review.
debriefText.missed: Compare old and new versions for content that was removed.
debriefText.falseFinding: Paper colour and font are not findings.
